software_class: account-based web product with persistent data, roles, and operational workflows

options.name: Modular web application monolith
options.when_to_use: Product scope needs cohesive UI, API, database, and roles.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when independent services are already justified.
options.rationale: Keeps product iteration and deployment simple.
options.tradeoffs: Scaling boundaries arrive later than in service-first designs.
options.risks: Large modules can blur ownership without clear boundaries.

options.name: API-first web application
options.when_to_use: Multiple clients or integration surfaces are expected early.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when a single web surface is enough.
options.rationale: Clarifies backend contracts and integration points.
options.tradeoffs: Adds contract maintenance and client coordination.
options.risks: Premature API breadth can slow product learning.

options.name: Service-split platform
options.when_to_use: Independent scaling, ownership, or compliance boundaries are proven.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid for early product discovery or small teams.
options.risks: Distributed complexity can hide product uncertainty.
